title: Waste of money!
text: Waste of money!. I'm 65 so I've had lots of towels in my life. I got these because they were cheap, but the reviews were pretty good so I got them to use on my dogs. I got them today and washed them, following the directions. Just took them out to put them into the dryer and the pink one just about shredded apart in my washing machine. Going to have to vacuum it out once it dries. I've had fuzz come off of new towels before but I've never seen anything like this before. SO glad I didn't put any other towels in the wash with them. What a mess. Doubt there will be anything left of that one to dry a dog with. We'll see about the others, which also left quite a lot of fuzz behind. Don't waste your money on these.
